title: gastrodia orobanchoides
intro: Gastrodia orobanchoides, commonly known as Tiger Lily or Chinese Gastrodia, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae and is native to Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and convulsions. The health benefits of Gastrodia orobanchoides include its anti-inflammatory, anti-convulsant, and neuroprotective properties, which make it a potential treatment for conditions such as epilepsy and Parkinson's disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenylethanoid glycosides, and other flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, analgesic, and antispasmodic effects.
